title: Marketplace catalog asks install-local where runtime-config says it is not mounted, and is answered 404
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: ① found while measuring objectstack-ai/cloud#4300 (hosted console calls to routes the host does not serve). Dedupe: `install-local 404 marketplace catalog`, `listLocalInstalls installLocal false` return no card.
Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4300 (Blocked-by this card; closes on a pin bump and a re-measure).

## 维护者速读

- 要做的：应用市场目录页像包详情页一样，只在 `features.installLocal` 为 true 时才读 install-local。
- 为什么：托管环境不挂载 install-local，runtime-config 也如实返回 `installLocal: false`，但目录页不看这个开关，每次加载和刷新都得到 404。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What happens

The catalog page `/_console/system/marketplace` asks `GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` on every first load and Refresh. A hosted environment answers `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`; its `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` answers `features.installLocal: false` in the same session. Measured on cloud main 7317e42 with the framework at b914e7247f (18.5.0).

- Caller: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx:476` (`Promise.all([listLocalInstalls(), listOrgPackages(), listInstalledPackages()])`), unchanged at objectstack main (`:473`).
- The package page already gates the same read on `getRuntimeConfig().features.installLocal` (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:371`).

## Change

1. The catalog's side load reads install-local only when `features.installLocal` is true.
2. Done when a test pins that no install-local request is made with `installLocal: false`, and the list still shows with it true.

Seam: `runtime:cloud-connection RuntimeConfigPlugin features.installLocal` → `renderer:MarketplacePage`.
